label: Philips Hue
notes: Bridge and lightstrips hold value best. A "Philips Hue UV Light Sanitizer Box" is not a smart bulb.

label: Inovelli / smart switch
notes: Inovelli rarely hits liquidation; Zooz/Caseta are the realistic equivalents. Hue excluded - it has its own row.

label: ANC headphones (Sony XM series)
notes: Confirmed: "mx4" meant the Sony WH-1000XM line, and XM6 is acceptable. Range runs XM3-XM7. px7 was matching IPX7 waterproof ratings until anchored.

label: Pebble watch
notes: Pebble as a material word is everywhere - regex requires a product noun. Core Devices makes the 2025 relaunch.

label: Ubiquiti / UniFi
notes: AP or switch. U7 is the WiFi 7 line. Bare E7 removed - it matched a foot callus remover. Dream Machine needs a brand or a model suffix - Sony sells a "Dream Machine" clock radio.

label: AR / VR glasses
match_regex: (meta quest|oculus|quest [23]|\mxreal\M|\mnreal\M|rokid|viture|valve index|htc vive|vision pro|\mar glasses\M|\mvr headset\M)
notes: Headsets and display glasses only. Quest accessories are a large and noisy category.

label: Mini PC (Intel QuickSync)
notes: Best Jellyfin transcode path. CPU pattern must sit beside a form-factor word - a bare N95 match pulled in 15.6in laptops.

label: Mini PC (AMD / other)
notes: Works for Jellyfin via VAAPI. "Mini PC Speakers" matched until speaker was excluded.

label: Rack PDU / UPS (Ubiquiti)
notes: Rack power for the homelab - Ubiquiti USP-PDU-Pro / SmartPower, or any rack-mount UPS. NOT a phone power bank; that was a misread and matched Dyson packs and hand warmers.

label: HDD / SSD
notes: TITLE ONLY. Watch for fake capacity - the 64TB Hard disik listings are counterfeit. Bare enclosure excluded; a drive-plus-enclosure bundle is the rare loss.

label: E-reader / e-ink
notes: TITLE ONLY - descriptions say "compatible with e-readers" constantly.

label: HVAC tools & controls
notes: Vacuum pump now needs an AC/HVAC qualifier - it was matching food vacuum sealers.

label: WiFi 7 AP / router (any brand)
notes: AP or router only. X870/B850 motherboards advertise WiFi 7 and were flooding this.

label: Gravel / cyclocross bike
match_regex: (gravel (bike|bicycle|frame)|cyclocross|\mcx\M (bike|frame)|drop[- ]bar.{0,14}(bike|bicycle)|trek checkpoint|specialized (diverge|crux)|cannondale topstone|canyon (grail|grizl)|surly (straggler|midnight special|crosscheck)|salsa (fargo|cutthroat|warbird|journeyman)|giant revolt|marin nicasio|kona (rove|sutra)|norco search|bianchi impulso)
notes: Drop-bar gravel/CX. Model names are brand-anchored: bare "grail" matched the holy grail of skincare. PAC never states frame size, so sizing comes from photos.
